title: Jude and the Portrait
author: Freya Dravenmoor
blurb: Quentin Dunmore, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
